## How it works

- [statement] Each 16-bit sub-channel commands its own bank cycle timing (tRC, tRP, tRCD), allowing concurrent row activations across independent bank groups. (high confidence) — https://www.jedec.org/standards-documents/docs/jesd239 · keywords: GDDR7 Four-Channel Interleaving Architecture · also: https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/blackwell-memory-architecture

## Facts and statements

- [statement] A standard 256-bit GDDR7 interface provides 16 pseudo-independent 16-bit sub-channels across four 64-bit physical memory controllers. (high confidence) — https://www.jedec.org/standards-documents/docs/jesd239 · keywords: GDDR7 Four-Channel Interleaving Architecture · also: https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/blackwell-memory-architecture
